games.name: SCORCHED EARTH 🔊
games.desc:
Hardcore Sandbox FPS, featuring advanced destruction, building, and volumetric smoke grenades.

Roblox Premium gives you 15% extra match bonus.

Private servers have everything unlocked & server tools, but stats dont transfer to the main game.

C / X: lower/raise stance
Q & E: lean
M: open squad menu
TAB: scoreboard
B: cycle firemode
V: melee (only for some tools and bayonets)
AIM + SHIFT: steady aim
AIM + SCROLL: zeroing (only on some weapons)
AIM + ALT: switch to irons
T: Squad orders/ping
CTRL / Tilde (~): aim (for laptop users)
C + SCROLL: incremental stances

Beta released on July 12th 2024.

games.name: [🎃] Alkedion PVP

ALKEDION PVP

Welcome to Alkedion PVP, a fast-paced third-person shooter where every fight is all about skill, movement, and teamwork. Challenge players from around the world, create your own clan, and prove yourself on the battlefield.

🎮 Game Modes

• Free For All (FFA)
• 1v1 Duels
• 2v2 - 5v5 Team Battles & Clan Wars

✨ Features

• Smooth and responsive third-person combat
• Roll, sprint, crouch, and outplay your opponents
• Collect unique weapon skins and effects
• Create or join a clan and compete with others
• Climb the leaderboards and earn rewards
• Frequent events, giveaways, and new content

🏆 Progress

Win matches, unlock rewards, improve your skills, and become one of the strongest players in Alkedion.

🖥️ PC Controls

• WASD – Move
• Mouse – Aim
• Left Click – Shoot
• Right Click – Aim / Zoom
• Space – Roll / Dodge
• Shift – Sprint
• C – Crouch
• R – Reload
• V – Open Inventory
